def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    r = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row))
    for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]):
        if v not in (2, 8):
            continue
        # The run of ones immediately to the right sets ray length.
        n = 0
        j = c + 1
        while j < w and grid[r][j] == 1:
            n += 1
            j += 1
        height = n + 1 if v == 2 else n
        height = min(height, r)
        for k in range(1, height + 1):
            rr = r - k
            out[rr][c] = v if k == height else 1
    return out
